parsed.explanation: The opening tag for the title was malformed; it lacked the closing angle bracket ('>'), causing the text 'Eine Tossanische Bibel' to be treated as part of the tag definition rather than the element content. I closed the <TITLE> tag to properly encapsulate the bibliographic data.
